h1: Custom Etched Coasters for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched coasters in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Durable, elegant drink coasters perfect for branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Etched coasters offer a permanent, sophisticated branding option that won't fade or peel over time. The etching process creates a subtle, elegant mark on materials like glass, stone, or metal, making these coasters ideal for upscale restaurants, corporate gifts, or trade show giveaways. Unlike printed coasters, etched designs withstand repeated washing and daily use, ensuring your logo remains crisp for years. Choose from round or square shapes in various sizes to match your brand's aesthetic.
heroAltText: Custom etched coasters featuring a laser-etched logo on a stone surface, displayed on a wooden table.
